主要内容: Brookfield Asset Management Inc. has announced the closing of a secondary offering of L.P. units. The filing, dated March 1, 2013, was incorporated by reference into the company's registration statement on Form F-9 (File No. 333-112049). The report was signed by B. D. Lawson, who holds the title of Managing Partner & CFO. The filing was submitted to the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) as part of the company's compliance with reporting requirements under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934. The filing was published on March 13, 2013, and includes details about the secondary offering, which is a common method for raising capital in the financial services sector.
